name: labs/filipdominec__rp2daq
title: RP2DAQ board (rp2daq.Rp2daq)
intro: RP2DAQ board (rp2daq.Rp2daq), adapted from filipdominec/rp2daq. It reads `adc_mean`, `stepper_position` and `stepper_moving`; sets `gpio_pin` and `gpio_level`; runs `adc_sample`, `pwm_set`, `stepper_init`, `stepper_move` and 1 more. `adc_sample`: capture one ADC block and return the mean raw count. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/filipdominec__rp2daq --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/filipdominec__rp2daq --backend fake --mcp
